title: BubbleNaut Survival
description: Just a Fabric modpack consisting of various optimization, QOL, and a few additional decoration mods.
body: Just a Fabric modpack consisting of various optimization, QOL, and a few additional decoration mods. I originally made this for my Wife and I, but a few of my freinds also really enjoyed playing it, so I decided to post it here as well! Currently , I have over 40 hours in the pack, and havent had any crashes or issues. This pack also supports dedicated servers (Ive been running one during mod curation just to make sure everything works as intended). I recommend dedicating 6-8GB of RAM to the client and server.
